The valuation of 400 USDC to INR is based on the TTBR on 2026-06-25, which is 94.00, resulting in 37600 INR.

limits: The valuation method is based on the TTBR on 2026-06-25, but the TTBR on 2026-06-29 is also considered to provide a range. The actual value could fall within this range.
